player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''big chief 4''') posted a [[Light]] Dantooine Y-wing list on DeckTech in October 2001.
description: Destroy them in the air with y wings
notes: Starting card as posted: Dantooine (starting location; no objective); it counts toward the 60.
Posted 'Y-Wings x59' dested the Premiere Light starfighter Y-wing (the only card titled Y-wing; not Gold Squadron Y-wing or Y-wing Assault Squadron).
The draft had the side as Dark; the post is tagged Light and both cards are Light, so the side is Light.
A one-location joke deck: 1 Dantooine + 59 Y-wing = 60. The same gimmick list appears later on Game Players Network as big_chief04 y-wing beats (December 2002).
